_comment: Wirewood Lodge untap BURST (MTG_UNTAP_BURST=0 restores the gap). Four Elves (Priest + 3 Llanowar) -> Priest taps for 4. Flat mana with the Lodge as a plain {C} land: 2 Forests + 3 Llanowar + Priest(4) + {C} = 10 -- one short of Worldspine Wurm's {8}{G}{G}{G} = 11. The burst line pays it: tap out for 9 {G}, then {G} + tap Lodge -> untap Priest -> tap it again for {G}{G}{G}{G}, netting 12. Modelled everywhere as the net-cancellation form (one Lodge tap = best tapped scaled Elf's yield minus the {G} feed, Elf's tapped state unchanged) -- pool credit in AddSourceToPool, flow oracle, backtracker burst branch, greedy kind-4.
